name: hcapp_findHashersByHashName
description: Pre-login account discovery. Searches for active hashers by hash name or last name and returns each matched hasher with their kennel memberships and run counts, so a new user can identify their existing account and request an invite code. Uses a global shared token validated against the null UUID (same mechanism as hcapp_authorizeDevice) — no device record is required. Optionally filters kennels by proximity: if @lat and @lon are provided, only kennels whose home city is within 500 miles (804,672 m) are returned.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Global shared token validated against the null UUID (00000000-...) and a 30-second time window. Not device-specific — used before device registration exists.

parameters.name: searchTerm
parameters.description: Hash name or last name substring to search. Minimum 2 characters. Used in LIKE '%term%' against Hasher.HashName and Hasher.LastName.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Device latitude for distance filter. Pass NULL to disable proximity filtering. Both @lat and @lon must be non-NULL to activate the filter.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Device longitude for distance filter. Pass NULL to disable proximity filtering. Both @lat and @lon must be non-NULL to activate the filter.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always returned as rowset 0. success=0 on auth or validation error; success=1 on success. Mutually exclusive with the error detail rowset at index 1.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. 1312 for auth failure, 1313 for search term too short.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 11 for auth failure, 2 for validation error.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Returned at index 1 when success=0. Contains the standard HC6 app error shape. Mutually exclusive with HasherResults rowset.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: HC.ErrorLog GUID for auth failures (not written for search-term validation errors).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification: 11 = auth failure, 2 = validation error.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: 1312 = auth failure, 1313 = search term too short.

columns.name: errorTitle
columns.description: 'Invalid access token' or 'Search term too short'.

rowsets.name: HasherResults
rowsets.description: Returned at index 1 when success=1. One row per matched hasher+kennel combination. Empty result set (zero rows) if no hashers match the search term. Ordered by PublicHasherId ASC, HcTotalRunCount DESC. Mutually exclusive with ErrorDetail rowset.

columns.name: publicHasherId
columns.description: LOWER(CAST(Hasher.PublicHasherId AS NVARCHAR(40))) — the public-facing hasher UUID, lowercased. Table column is UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL.

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName — computed persisted column (COALESCE of HashName/FirstName+LastName, falls back to '<no names provided>'). Never NULL in practice.

columns.name: hashName
columns.description: COALESCE(Hasher.HashName, '') — hash name, empty string if NULL. Table column is NVARCHAR(250) NULL.

columns.name: photo
columns.description: COALESCE(Hasher.Photo, '') — photo URL, empty string if NULL. Table column is NVARCHAR(1000) NULL.

columns.name: kennelId
columns.description: LOWER(CAST(Kennel.id AS NVARCHAR(40))) — the kennel's internal UUID, lowercased. Table column is UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL.

columns.name: kennelName
columns.description: Kennel.KennelName. Table column is NVARCHAR(250) NOT NULL.

columns.name: runCount
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.HcTotalRunCount — number of HC-tracked runs at this kennel. Filter requires > 0 (only hashers with at least one run are returned). Table column is INT NOT NULL.

sideEffects: Writes to HC.ErrorLog on auth failure (errorId is a NEWID() value).

No write to HC.ErrorLog on search-term validation failure (errorId is NEWID() but not persisted — note: SP code sets @errorId = NEWID() but does NOT insert into HC.ErrorLog for the search-term-too-short case).

codeSmells.issue: errorId populated but not logged for search-term validation failure
codeSmells.detail: When @searchTerm is too short (errorCode 1313), the SP sets @errorId = NEWID() and returns it in the error rowset, but never inserts into HC.ErrorLog. The client receives a GUID that does not correspond to any error log entry. This is inconsistent with auth failures where the log entry is always written.

@lat and @lon are FLOAT. While FLOAT is appropriate for geographic coordinates (not monetary values), it is inconsistent with the HC.Device table which stores Latitude and Longitude as DECIMAL(18,15)/DECIMAL(19,15). The geography::Point() call still works correctly since SQL Server converts implicitly.

The main SELECT has no error handling. An unexpected DB error (geography::Point() failure on bad coordinates, deadlock, timeout) will propagate as a raw SQL error rather than a structured error rowset.

codeSmells.issue: c.CityGeolocation IS NULL rows always pass the distance filter
codeSmells.detail: The WHERE predicate includes 'OR c.CityGeolocation IS NULL' so kennels whose city has no geolocation are always included even when @lat/@lon is provided. This is a deliberate fallback but may surprise callers who expect distance filtering to be strict.

breakingChanges: This SP does not call HC6.ValidateAppAuth — it uses a direct HC.CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 call with the null UUID. Auth errorType is 11 (not the standard 1 or 3 used by device-authenticated SPs).
The errorId for search-term validation errors is a client-generated NEWID() with no corresponding HC.ErrorLog row — support lookup by errorId will return no results for errorCode 1313.
Returned UUIDs (publicHasherId, kennelId) are NVARCHAR(40) lowercase strings, not UNIQUEIDENTIFIER — callers must not cast them back to GUID without normalising case first.
